doc.name: G — 30s startup launch day set in a mountain village, high-energy in tone, a pair of rivals, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: startup launch day set in a mountain village, high-energy in tone
Hero: a pair of rivals
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the startup launch day set in a mountain village, high-energy in tone form, built around a pair of rivals.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. Keep the same time of day across all three acts unless the story's turn requires otherwise — and if it does, state the change explicitly.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a snap zoom in followed by a settle in Act 1 against a rack focus pulling from foreground occlusion to the subject in Act 3 — while holding the a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second startup launch day set in a mountain village, high-energy in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a crane-down descending from overhead into a level medium, shot on a 105mm macro at f/2.8, framed with deep negative space above the subject with a low horizon.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with paired strip-box rim lights raking both edges of the subject; grade as near-monochrome with a single accent hue allowed to stay saturated. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. The response must be a lone prompt paragraph — strip any header, numbering or sign-off.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second startup launch day set in a mountain village, high-energy in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves, shot on an 8mm circular fisheye at f/2.8, framed with diagonal dynamic balance across the frame.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with an overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all; grade as a neutral commercial grade with clean whites and no colour cast. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, and low quality.

OUTPUT. Your entire reply is the prompt itself: one dense paragraph, no title, no quotation marks, no trailing notes.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second startup launch day set in a mountain village, high-energy in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same pair of rivals.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a low-mounted tracking shot skimming just above the ground, shot on a 28mm at f/2, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with LED tube accents in two contrasting hues placed in depth; grade as a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo
